basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old guy from Denver, Colorado, currently working as a freelance graphic designer. I recently discovered Reddit and I'm still figuring out the ropes. I'm interested in video editing, gaming, and exploring new hobbies online. I don't have a set schedule, so I often browse Reddit at different times throughout the day. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time experimenting with different creative software and indulging in some casual gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge mainly comes from self-teaching and online tutorials. I've been using graphic design software like Adobe Photoshop and Premiere Pro for a couple of years now. I love learning new techniques from YouTube and experimenting with them on personal projects.
